rows.before: <li>We prepare the SR&ED claim on Form T661 alongside your technology startup T2 return for qualifying experimental software development \u2014 the 35% refundable ITC on the first $3 million in eligible expenditures can recover a significant portion of your developer salaries, cloud compute costs for R&D environments, and contractor development fees each fiscal year.<\/li>\r\n

rows.section: Services grid - tax planning card bullet
rows.before: <li>We plan SR&ED claims within CRA's 18-month filing deadline and coordinate the timing with your tech startup's fiscal year-end to maximize the refundable ITC \u2014 for CCPCs with taxable capital under $10 million, the 35% refundable rate applies to the first $3 million in qualifying expenditures, and we ensure your claim captures all eligible developer time, cloud R&D compute, and contractor costs.<\/li>\r\n
We prioritize catch-up T2 returns where the 18-month window has not yet closed to recover those credits before the deadline passes.

rows.before: <li>We correct misclassified SR&ED expenditures where your previous accountant lumped qualifying development labour with general operating expenses on prior T2 returns \u2014 properly separating eligible costs and filing amended Form T661 claims recovers SR&ED refunds that were never claimed for each affected fiscal year within the 18-month deadline.<\/li>\r\n

rows.section: Services grid - CRA audit card bullet
